final: WITH scope_fees AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, avg_net_fee_rate, fee_record_count, avg_net_fee_rate - AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_scope_average FROM scope_fees
